data.name: CPF_001
data.value: Halt.[pause=25] No one crosses this ledge without our leave.

data.name: CPF_002
data.value: The roost lies just above.[pause=20] We have guarded it since the air changed.

data.name: CPF_003
data.value: Three pairs of wings against two pairs of feet.[pause=20] Turn back,[pause=15] or learn to fly.

data.name: CPF_R01
data.value: The ledge is deserted.[pause=20] Not one shadow left above the path.

data.name: CPF_R02
data.value: (Scales caught in the ice,[pause=15] and long claw marks on the stone.[pause=20] They kept a close watch here.)

data.name: CPF_R03
data.value: They let us through this time.[pause=15] Or they moved higher up.

data.name: CPF_R04
data.value: There's nothing left to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
